Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-hiv-int-lab-form-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-hiv-int-lab-form-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
test-type-viral-load Viral loadA viral-load test is requested.
test-type-eid Early infant diagnosisAn early-infant-diagnosis test is requested.
test-type-other Other laboratory testOne or more other laboratory investigations are requested.
eid-age-less-than-or-equal-72-hours 72 hours or youngerInfant age is 72 hours or younger at specimen collection.
eid-age-over-72-hours-under-2-months Older than 72 hours and younger than 2 monthsInfant age is greater than 72 hours and less than 2 months.
eid-age-2-to-12-months 2 to 12 monthsInfant age is at least 2 months and not more than 12 months.
eid-age-over-12-months Older than 12 monthsInfant age is greater than 12 months.
arv-prophylaxis-azt-nvp AZT + NVPZidovudine and nevirapine prophylaxis.
arv-prophylaxis-nvp NVPNevirapine prophylaxis.
arv-prophylaxis-azt-3tc-nvp-ral AZT + 3TC + NVP/RALZidovudine, lamivudine and nevirapine or raltegravir prophylaxis as printed on the source form.
arv-prophylaxis-other Other ARV prophylaxisAn ARV-prophylaxis regimen not represented by another code; specify separately.
arv-prophylaxis-none No ARV prophylaxisNo ARV prophylaxis was received.
regimen-line-first First-line regimenThe client is receiving a first-line ART regimen.
regimen-line-second Second-line regimenThe client is receiving a second-line ART regimen.
regimen-line-third Third-line regimenThe client is receiving a third-line ART regimen.
vl-indication-baseline-six-months Baseline: six months after ART initiationBaseline viral-load testing six months after ART initiation.
vl-indication-routine-annual Routine: every 12 monthsRoutine annual viral-load monitoring.
vl-indication-clinical-immunologic-failure Clinical or immunologic failureViral-load testing requested because of suspected clinical or immunologic treatment failure.
vl-indication-gestation-32-36-weeks 32–36 weeks of gestationViral-load testing requested at 32–36 weeks of gestation.
vl-indication-confirmation-after-eac Confirmation: three to six months after EACConfirmatory viral-load testing three to six months after enhanced adherence counselling.
vl-indication-recent-infection Recent infectionViral-load testing requested in the context of recent HIV infection.
vl-indication-early-hiv-detection Early HIV detectionViral-load testing requested for early HIV detection.
eid-indication-at-birth EID at birthEarly infant diagnosis requested at birth.
eid-indication-six-eight-weeks EID at 6–8 weeksEarly infant diagnosis requested at six to eight weeks.
eid-indication-two-twelve-months EID at 2–12 monthsEarly infant diagnosis requested between two and twelve months.
eid-indication-repeat-invalid Repeat because of invalid testThe EID test is repeated because a previous result was invalid.
eid-indication-after-breastfeeding Repeat after cessation of breastfeedingRepeat EID at least six weeks after the last exposure to breast milk.
specimen-whole-blood Whole bloodWhole-blood specimen.
specimen-plasma PlasmaPlasma specimen.
specimen-dbs DBSDried blood spot specimen.
specimen-pbs PBSPBS as printed on the source form; the expansion is not specified by the source workbook.
other-test-cd4-count CD4+ cell countAbsolute CD4+ cell count.
other-test-cd4-percentage CD4 percentageCD4 percentage.
other-test-cd4-lfa CD4 LFACD4 lateral-flow assay.
other-test-tb-lf-lam TB LF-LAMTuberculosis lateral-flow urine lipoarabinomannan test.
other-test-serum-crag Serum CrAgSerum cryptococcal antigen test.
other-test-csf-crag CSF CrAgCerebrospinal-fluid cryptococcal antigen test.
other-test-csf-mcs CSF M/C/SCerebrospinal-fluid microscopy, culture and sensitivity.
other-test-hbsag HBsAgHepatitis B surface antigen test.
other-test-hcv-antibody HCV antibodyHepatitis C virus antibody test.
other-test-hbv-viral-load HBV viral loadHepatitis B virus viral-load test.
other-test-hcv-viral-load HCV viral loadHepatitis C virus viral-load test.
other-test-syphilis SyphilisSyphilis serology.
other-test-hpv HPVHuman papillomavirus test.
other-test-cytology CytologyCytology or cervical-screening test, including VIA or Pap smear as printed on the source form.
other-test-random-glucose Random glucoseRandom blood-glucose test.
other-test-naat NAATNucleic-acid amplification test; the target organism is not specified on the source form.
other-test-urinalysis UrinalysisUrinalysis.
result-negative NegativeThe qualitative laboratory result is negative.
result-positive PositiveThe qualitative laboratory result is positive.
result-invalid InvalidThe test result is invalid.
result-non-reactive Non-reactiveThe serology result is non-reactive.
result-reactive ReactiveThe serology result is reactive.
cytology-method-via VIAVisual inspection with acetic acid.
cytology-method-pap-smear Pap smearPapanicolaou cervical cytology.
